integrity: The theorem is proved by exact finite-field incidence identities and finite-character orthogonality. Finite computations are corroboration, not the proof. Self-review only; no independent audit or external certification.
limitations: Pure unweighted prime-dimensional graph states only; base graph is finite simple loopless undirected.
The quantum bipartition corresponds exactly to a partition of base-graph edges, and no claims are made for arbitrary graphs not of line-graph form.
The formula does not cover composite local dimensions, edge weights, noisy states, interactions, finite-temperature effects or time evolution.
Historical-priority assessment is based on the compared sources and is not a proof of absolute uniqueness.
title: Prime-characteristic entanglement of line-graph qudit states from signed component overlaps
